name: Compact 10,000mAh Power Bank
problemSolved: Tops up a phone 1–2x without an outlet.
failureMoment: Phone at 4% on the platform, no wall outlet in sight.
cons: Usable output below printed mAh (conversion loss)
may not reach 100% twice on big phones
forbiddenClaims: 'charges your phone X times' as fact
visualAngle: Macro on a black slab, single rim of light, USB-C cable snaking into darkness; battery LEDs pulsing 1→4.
videoHook: 4 percent. No outlet. The train's already here.

name: High-Capacity 20,000mAh USB-C PD Power Bank
problemSolved: Multi-day or two-person charging off-grid.
failureMoment: Day two of travel, three dead devices, one wall plug.
visualAngle: Two cables in low-key split light, percent display glowing in a dark hand; slow push-in.
videoHook: Two phones. One outlet. A 9-hour layover.

name: 65W GaN Multi-Port Wall Charger
problemSolved: Replaces 2–3 bricks; charges laptop + phone from one outlet.
failureMoment: One hotel outlet, a dead laptop, and a dying phone.
cons: Full 65W usually on a single port only
forbiddenClaims: full wattage on all ports at once
visualAngle: Tiny cube isolated on black, folding prongs catching one hard key light; cables radiating like spokes.
videoHook: Three chargers. One outlet. Pick the one that does all three.

name: Multi-Port USB-C Car Charger
problemSolved: Fast-charges phones from the 12V socket.
failureMoment: Navigation on, phone draining faster than the dashboard charges it.
cons: High wattage depends on the car's 12V circuit
forbiddenClaims: guaranteeing peak wattage regardless of vehicle
visualAngle: Glowing ring in a dark dashboard socket, retractable cable pulled taut into shadow.
videoHook: Maps on. Battery dropping. The dash is supposed to be helping.

name: Universal 6-in-1 Charging Cable Kit
problemSolved: One cable covers USB-C / Lightning / micro-USB.
failureMoment: Right cable, wrong tip — again.
allowedClaims: marketed as a single multi-device cable
forbiddenClaims: full data speeds on all tips
visualAngle: A single braided cable coiled like a serpent, tips fanned in a shaft of light.
videoHook: Right cable. Wrong end. Story of your life.

name: Compact Portable Power Station (~300Wh)
problemSolved: Runs small devices / AC appliances during outages or off-grid.
failureMoment: Power's out, fridge ticking down, phones the only light left.
cons: Will NOT run high-draw appliances long-term
forbiddenClaims: runtime numbers as fact for unstated loads
visualAngle: Monolith on concrete in a blacked-out room, single AC outlet glowing, a lamp casting the only warm pool of light.
videoHook: The grid blinks out. Yours doesn't.

name: Magnetic Wireless Power Bank (Qi2 / MagSafe-compatible)
problemSolved: Snaps to a compatible phone for cable-free top-ups.
failureMoment: Phone dying, hands full, no time to thread a cable.
cons: Wireless slower and warmer than wired
visualAngle: Slow magnetic 'click' onto a phone in the dark, blue ring of wireless light blooming at the seam.
videoHook: No cable. No outlet. Just snap and walk.

name: Rugged Solar Power Bank (Waterproof)
problemSolved: Off-grid charging with emergency solar trickle + built-in light.
failureMoment: Day three of the trail, no outlet for 40 miles.
cons: Solar is a slow trickle, NOT primary charge
visualAngle: Mud-flecked brick on wet rock, water beading, solar cells catching a cold dawn; flashlight cutting fog.
videoHook: 40 miles from the nearest outlet. The sun's your only plug.

name: 100W Laptop USB-C Power Bank
problemSolved: Charges USB-C laptops away from an outlet.
failureMoment: Laptop at 8%, deadline in 40 minutes, café outlet taken.
visualAngle: Laptop lid glow in a dark room, thick cable to a slab on the table, percent ticking up.
videoHook: 8 percent. 40 minutes. No outlet.

name: Universal Travel Power Adapter (All-in-One)
problemSolved: One plug works across US/UK/EU/AU + USB charging.
failureMoment: Landed overseas, wrong plug shape, dead phone, foreign airport.
visualAngle: Cube rotating in a dark frame, each region's prongs sliding out under a single beam; passport edge in shadow.
videoHook: New country. Dead phone. Wrong plug.

name: Portable Lithium Jump Starter
problemSolved: Starts a dead 12V battery without a second car.
failureMoment: Dead battery in an empty lot, nobody to ask for a jump.
allowedClaims: Lithium jump starter for 12V (engine-size limits apply)
visualAngle: Clamps biting a battery terminal in the dark, single green 'ready' LED, breath-fog in cold air.
videoHook: Empty lot. Dead battery. No one to flag down.

name: Cordless Rechargeable Tire Inflator
problemSolved: Re-inflates a low/flat tire without a gas-station pump.
failureMoment: Low-pressure light at night, every gas-station air pump out of order.
cons: Slower than corded/12V for big tires
visualAngle: Nozzle threading onto a valve stem in the rain, digital PSI climbing in cold blue light, tire shoulder filling.
videoHook: Low-pressure light. 11pm. Every air pump 'out of service.'

name: Front-Facing Dash Cam (1080p–4K)
problemSolved: Records the road for incident evidence.
failureMoment: A fender-bender, and it's your word against theirs.
cons: parking mode may need a hardwire kit
allowedClaims: Records video to a memory card
visualAngle: Windshield-mounted lens reflecting passing streetlights, red REC dot pulsing, wipers sweeping rain.
videoHook: Their word against yours. Unless something was watching.

name: Dual-Channel Dash Cam (Front + Rear)
problemSolved: Records front AND rear simultaneously.
failureMoment: Rear-ended at a light — and the only proof is behind you.
allowedClaims: Records front and rear to memory card
visualAngle: Split-frame: headlights ahead, taillights behind, both lenses glinting; rain on glass.
videoHook: It came from behind. So did the proof.

name: Collapsible Trunk Organizer
problemSolved: Stops groceries/gear sliding around the trunk.
failureMoment: Hard brake, and the whole grocery run rolls under the seats.
keyFeatures: non-slip base + straps on better units
forbiddenClaims: 'keeps food cold for hours' as fact
visualAngle: Single hard light over an open trunk, compartments crisp with shadow, one bottle standing upright as the car corners.
videoHook: One hard brake. Groceries everywhere.

name: Cordless Handheld Car Vacuum
problemSolved: Cleans crumbs, sand, pet hair from tight car spaces.
failureMoment: Picking someone up in 10 minutes and the seats are a disaster.
visualAngle: Nozzle gliding over a dark floor mat, dust motes lifting through a single beam, crumbs vanishing.
videoHook: Ten minutes until pickup. The seats look like a crime scene.

name: Roadside Emergency Kit
problemSolved: Bundles jumper cables + basics for common breakdowns.
failureMoment: Breakdown on the shoulder with nothing in the trunk but a spare you can't reach.
cons: Jumper cables need a second running car
allowedClaims: Bundled roadside kit; contents vary by tier
includes jumper cables / warning triangle (per listing)
visualAngle: Hazard triangle reflecting headlights on a dark shoulder, kit unrolled on asphalt, breath in cold air.
videoHook: Shoulder of the highway. Trunk's empty. Now what?

name: Magnetic Vent / Dash Phone Mount (MagSafe-compatible)
problemSolved: Holds the phone for navigation, hands-free.
failureMoment: Phone slides off the seat mid-turn while you're following directions.
cons: Needs genuine MagSafe/Qi2 or a metal ring
allowedClaims: Magnetic phone mount; MagSafe/Qi2-compatible on stated models
forbiddenClaims: universal magnetic hold without a ring/MagSafe
visualAngle: Phone 'snapping' to the mount in the dark cabin, charging ring glowing, city lights streaking past.
videoHook: One sharp turn. The phone hits the floor. So does your exit.

name: Bluetooth OBD2 Diagnostic Scanner
problemSolved: Reads the check-engine code via a phone app.
failureMoment: Check-engine light pops on the morning of a road trip.
cons: Some need a paid app for full features
advanced systems may need brand apps
allowedClaims: Reads/clears OBD2 trouble codes via app
visualAngle: Tiny dongle glowing under the dash, phone screen lighting a face in the dark with a single fault code.
videoHook: Check engine. The morning you're supposed to leave town.

name: Car Emergency Escape Tool (Seatbelt Cutter + Window Breaker)
problemSolved: Designed to cut a jammed seatbelt and break tempered side glass.
failureMoment: Jammed seatbelt; you need out of the vehicle fast.
keyFeatures: Spring-loaded/hammer point for tempered side glass
cons: Many modern side/laminated windshields resist breaking
not a substitute for a seatbelt
allowedClaims: Has a recessed blade intended to cut seatbelt webbing
spring point intended to break tempered side glass
visualAngle: Orange tool resting in a dark cupholder, single hard light on the steel point; tension framing, no violence shown.
videoHook: The one tool you hope you never reach for.

name: Rechargeable EDC Flashlight
problemSolved: Bright, pocketable light on demand.
failureMoment: Power's out and your phone torch is at 3%.
visualAngle: Single beam cutting a black room, knurled body rotating in a hand, dust catching the cone of light.
videoHook: Lights out. Phone at 3 percent. Now you need the real thing.

name: Collapsible Rechargeable Emergency Lantern
problemSolved: 360° room light during an outage.
failureMoment: Storm knocks the power out; the house goes black.
visualAngle: Lantern blooming to fill a black kitchen, warm pool of light, a hand collapsing/expanding it in slow motion.
videoHook: The storm took the lights. This brings the room back.

name: Rechargeable Headlamp (Motion/Wave Sensor)
problemSolved: Hands-free light for work/repairs/night tasks.
failureMoment: Fixing something under the sink/car in the dark, both hands full.
bestFor: DIY / camping / dog walks / power outages
allowedClaims: actual output may be below advertised
visualAngle: Beam swinging across a dark engine bay or crawlspace, hands working in the light, breath visible.
videoHook: Both hands busy. Zero light. Now what.

name: Magnetic Rechargeable LED Work Light
problemSolved: Hands-free directed light that sticks to metal.
failureMoment: Roadside repair at night, nowhere to set a light.
visualAngle: Light snapping to a car's underside, hard shadows raking across metal, single warm spill on a wrench.
videoHook: Broke down at night. Nowhere to set the light.

name: Wireless Stick-On Motion-Sensor LED Light
problemSolved: Auto-lights hallways/closets/stairs when you pass.
failureMoment: 2am hallway, fumbling for a switch that isn't there.
visualAngle: A strip blinking on as a silhouette passes in a black hallway, light chasing the footsteps.
videoHook: 2am. Dark hallway. The switch is never where you reach.

name: Compact Keychain Flashlight
problemSolved: Always-on-you micro light for locks, bags, drops.
failureMoment: Dropped keys in the dark gap between the car and the curb.
visualAngle: A pinpoint beam finding keys in a dark gutter, keyring swinging, reflection in a puddle.
videoHook: Keys, gone. Into the dark gap by the curb.

name: LED Camping Lantern with Power-Bank Function
problemSolved: Area light that also tops up a phone.
failureMoment: Campsite after dark, phone dying, no power for miles.
visualAngle: Lantern glowing on a picnic table at night, a phone cable trailing into the dark, moths in the beam.
videoHook: Dark campsite. Dying phone. No outlet for 30 miles.

name: Outdoor Motion-Activated Security Light (Solar/Battery)
problemSolved: Auto-lights driveways, doors, dark exterior corners.
failureMoment: Pulling into a pitch-black driveway, fumbling at the door.
visualAngle: A flood snapping on as a car rolls into a black driveway, long shadow thrown across wet pavement.
videoHook: Pitch-black driveway. Keys in one hand, groceries in the other.

name: Rechargeable LED Road Flares (Set)
problemSolved: Makes a stopped vehicle visible at night without fire.
failureMoment: Broken down on a dark shoulder, headlights barreling toward you.
allowedClaims: LED roadside beacon set; multiple flash modes
visualAngle: Three pulsing red discs spaced down a dark wet highway shoulder, reflective rings glowing, rain streaking past.
videoHook: Dark shoulder. Headlights coming. Make sure they see you.

name: Rechargeable COB Work Floodlight / Area Light
problemSolved: Broad, even light for a whole work area.
failureMoment: Power's out and you need to see the whole garage, not a pinpoint.
visualAngle: A flat wall of light filling a black garage, tools emerging from shadow, the panel swinging on a hook.
videoHook: You don't need a pinpoint. You need to see everything.

name: Bluetooth Item Tracker (Tag)
problemSolved: Helps locate keys/bag/wallet via a phone + finding network.
failureMoment: Keys gone, you're already late, tearing the house apart.
cons: NOT GPS — relies on nearby network devices
allowedClaims: Bluetooth tracker using a crowd-sourced finding network
visualAngle: A disc tucked into a dark bag pocket, a soft pulse of light, phone map dropping a pin.
videoHook: Keys, gone. You're already late.

name: Slim Card Tracker (Wallet Finder)
problemSolved: Credit-card-thin tracker that fits a wallet.
failureMoment: Wallet missing, no idea if it's home or gone.
cons: slower to recharge / non-replaceable battery on some
allowedClaims: Card-format Bluetooth tracker via finding network
visualAngle: Card sliding between bills in a dark wallet, edge catching one line of light, phone map pinging.
videoHook: Wallet's gone. Or is it just... somewhere.

name: Anti-Theft Travel Backpack (USB Pass-Through)
problemSolved: Harder-to-access zippers + organized, chargeable carry.
failureMoment: Crowded transit station, bag on your back, hands not free.
cons: USB port needs your own power bank
visualAngle: Bag turning in a slow spotlight, hidden zipper revealed against the back panel, USB port glinting.
videoHook: Packed station. Bag on your back. Someone's hands too close.

name: Travel Cable Organizer Roll / Pouch
problemSolved: Tames the tangle of cables, chargers, dongles.
failureMoment: Digging through a bag of knotted cables while boarding is called.
cons: Small versions don't fit a big GaN brick
organization only (no protection rating unless stated)
allowedClaims: Cable/accessory organizer with loops and pockets
visualAngle: Roll unfurling in a single beam, cables seated in a neat row, hands cinching the strap.
videoHook: Boarding's called. Your cables are one giant knot.

name: Electronics Travel Organizer (Tech Pouch)
problemSolved: One padded home for all small electronics.
failureMoment: Security bin chaos — chargers, dongles, batteries everywhere.
visualAngle: Clamshell opening like a case reveal, each device in its slot under raking light, zipper pull swinging.
videoHook: Security bin. Everything you own, loose and rolling.

name: TSA-Approved Combination Travel Lock
problemSolved: Secures luggage zippers while staying TSA-inspectable.
failureMoment: Checked bag on a carousel, zippers wide open and unsecured.
visualAngle: Dials clicking into place in a tight macro, brass body against black fabric, zipper pulls drawn together.
videoHook: Carousel. Your bag. Zippers wide open.

name: Compact Pocket Multi-Tool
problemSolved: Pliers, blade, drivers, scissors in one pocket tool.
failureMoment: A loose screw / stuck package / snipped tag — and not a single tool around.
cons: Blade carry restricted in some venues (airport = checked only)
visualAngle: Tool unfolding in slow motion under one hard light, steel pivoting open, edges catching the gleam.
videoHook: One loose screw. Zero tools. Every time.

name: Travel Packing Cubes (Set)
problemSolved: Compresses + sorts clothes so a bag holds more, neatly.
failureMoment: Repacking an exploded suitcase on a hotel bed at 6am.
allowedClaims: Set of zip packing cubes; compression on stated models
visualAngle: Cubes zipping shut and stacking like clean bricks in a dark case, one mesh top glowing from within.
videoHook: 6am. Wrong city. Suitcase exploded across the bed.

name: RFID-Blocking Travel Wallet / Passport Holder
problemSolved: Organizes passport + cards + boarding pass in one place.
failureMoment: At the gate, juggling passport, phone, and boarding pass with no free hand.
cons: Real-world RFID card theft is rare
visualAngle: Wallet opening to fan passport + cards under a single warm beam, boarding pass edge catching light.
videoHook: At the gate. Passport, phone, boarding pass. One free hand.

name: Digital Handheld Luggage Scale
problemSolved: Weighs a bag before check-in to dodge overweight fees.
failureMoment: At the counter, the scale reads 2 lb over and the agent points at the fee chart.
cons: hard to read a swinging heavy bag
allowedClaims: Digital luggage scale (lb/kg); capacity & accuracy vary by model
visualAngle: Bag lifted on a strap in the dark, red digits climbing on the display, the number settling just under the line.
videoHook: Two pounds over. And the fee chart is right there.
